sports.note: Hand corrections for tools/trace-ground.mjs --layer sports. extraSites: grounds not (fully) in OSM; sites.<id>: skip, margin, hints, drop (fit names), surfaces / lines (world frame) added as they are.

markings.note: Areas whose road paint tools/trace-ground.mjs --layer markings traces (cut into cells of `cell` metres). Inside them the traced paint replaces the rule-based markings (js/road-paint.js, js/city-grid.js).

classes.note: Areas whose open ground tools/trace-ground.mjs --layer classes classifies (every hires orthophoto tile touching them) into data/ground-classes/.
